blocks.text: ATOMIC SEMANTIC REVIEW COMPLETE — CURRENT STATUS

Era Zero now has all 324 atomic roots canonical, 0 provisional roots, and 0 unreviewed nine-root chunks. All 288 model-generated roots have passed detailed selective review while the 36 source-developed roots remain unchanged. The complete regression passes 29 current-authority checks, all 2,592 generated-form assertions, the reusable final-packet contract, and every configured full-family audit.

No further atomic semantic packet remains. The broad English translator is still blocked by the unapproved compound architecture, English sense index, semantic IR, executable grammar, renderer, and decoder. A restricted explicit-ID renderer may cover all 324 canonical roots but must reject unapproved compounds and underspecified grammar. Gate 4, compound architecture, and translator implementation remain deferred.
